author: Xiaomi

What stunning views can you capture while moving through fireworks?

Powered by LOFIC ultra-high dynamic range technology, #Xiaomi17Ultra enhances dynamic range frame by frame and intelligently adapts exposure — enabling ultra-pure night video, even in motion.

Stay tuned for more incredible upgrades at the #XiaomiLaunch on February 28th, 14:00 (GMT+1).
